thread.title: Close Update: Apple Sales Warning Helps Push Investors Out of Stocks Sending Market Indexes Tumbling

author: MT Newswires
title: Close Update: Apple Sales Warning Helps Push Investors Out of Stocks Sending Market Indexes Tumbling
text:
Shutterstock photo Major market averages swooned on Thursday as investors dumped stocks after Apple ( AAPL ) warned that sales would be below expectations and US manufacturing data showed signs the economy is slowing.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index led the market lower, plunging 3%, with Apple tumbling 10%. The iPhone maker said it expects sales of $84 billion for Q1, well below the Street consensus of $91.4 billion, blaming the shortfall on slumping demand in China.
Stocks were also hit by weak economic news. The December ISM manufacturing index slid to its lowest level in two-years, as new orders plunged to 51.1 from November's 62.1, and the price index fell to 54.9 from 60.7.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 660 points, or 2.8%, dragged down by Apple, Intel ( INTC ) and United Technologies ( UTX ). The S&P 500 tumbled 2.5%.
Technology was the biggest losing sector in the S&P 500, followed by industrials, basic materials and financials. Shares of utilities and real estate companies managed slight gains.
The bad news from Apple overshadowed other corporate news, including Bristol-Myers Squibb's ( BMY ) $74 billion deal to buy Celgene ( CELG ). Bristol-Myers fell 13%, while Celgene climbed 20.7%.
